purpose: First durable next-generation queue compiled from worker returns + explicit parent/steward dispositions + fresh critic findings, without human task-by-task design. This proves generation preparation, not yet the executable recursive compiler itself.
claim_protocol: Exclusive create-if-absent at coordination/opportunities/claims/<opportunity_id>.json. Losing a race means reload current active queues and select another compatible READY item; never overwrite.
run_protocol: Claim -> STARTED -> context/acceptance receipt -> execute acceptance checkpoints -> RETURN -> DONE. Opportunity-specific write_scope below is explicit authority for candidate-only files; shared Current/Human Accepted/Served/architecture heads remain off-limits.

opportunities.mission: Implement the smallest deterministic repository Planner compiler from the consumed recursive-Planner contract. Create scripts/compile-planner-generation.mjs plus deterministic tests and candidate generation fixtures. The compiler must consume immutable generation input + typed dispositions, emit stable PREPARED opportunities/DAG/frontier, preserve authority/privacy blockers, be idempotent on identical inputs, and never synthesize Current/Human Accepted/Served. Produce executable repository artifacts, not another prose-only design.
acceptance_criteria: same input yields same logical opportunity set
candidate N+1 output emitted from durable inputs without human task wording
opportunities.return_contract: Code/test/fixture evidence + exact boundary before live N+1->N+2 canary.

opportunities.mission: Implement the smallest replayable typed Steward disposition bridge used by the Planner compiler. Schema and validator must support scope-aware CONSUMED/DEFERRED/CONFLICTED/REJECTED_WITH_REASON/NOT_APPLICABLE without rewriting immutable RETURNs or treating missing disposition as acceptance.
opportunities.return_contract: Executable schema/validator/tests + Planner compiler handoff fields.

opportunities.mission: Build Context Fabric Lite P1: deterministic artifact inventory with explicit durable-ID precedence/path fallback, sparse explicit reference graph, exact+lexical retrieval, mandatory hard closure for authority/privacy/freshness/contradictions, context compiler and durable receipt payload. No embeddings, pgvector or generated-prose dependency in P1.
acceptance_criteria: hard constraints cannot be ranked away
bounded Working Set has stage-level reasons
gold/falsification tests pass without vector/database dependency
opportunities.return_contract: Runnable P1 candidate + automated-context canary evidence.

opportunities.mission: Build a non-deployed candidate Prometeo Metabolism Tick v1. Implement deterministic source scan and shadow Control Room/Planner-trigger/launch-demand projections with pinned-head/idempotence/drift/privacy tests. Workflow draft must remain outside .github/workflows so it cannot activate scheduling yet.
acceptance_criteria: tick derives shadow state from pinned head
planner trigger fails honestly when compiler unavailable
opportunities.return_contract: Runnable candidate tick + tests + deployment prerequisites.

opportunities.mission: Close Wave1 verifier gaps with append-only claim-attempt receipts, stable session/previous_run continuation lineage, STARTED persistence receipts and actual changed-path/write-set evidence. Build a small schema/test fixture proving an independent verifier can reconstruct races/order/scope without trusting worker prose.
opportunities.return_contract: Receipt schema/tests and updated evidence grades for prior downgrades.

opportunities.mission: Run live compiler-emitted N+1 workers and feed results through same compiler to emit N+2 without human task wording.
acceptance_criteria: two generated jobs execute normal lifecycle

opportunities.mission: Independently verify or reject recursive Planner operational status from exact N input, emitted N+1, worker lifecycle, typed dispositions and emitted N+2 evidence.
